ops.title: cc-present board usability pass
ops.body:
# cc-present board usability pass

## Context

Using a cc-present focus board, the owner hit four bugs (option preview squeezed to one line, preview snapping back to the first card, a reply toast that says nothing, the Other box emptying itself), asked for an audit of the rest, and added that every card must take a note. The audit, read against `origin/main` (cc-present `56d948f`, v0.40.1 installed; cc-interact `ed6cf80`), confirmed 20 more defects in four groups. All of it ships: nothing is deferred.

Repos: `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-present` (Go daemon, `web/src` SPA, `ios/`, `plugin/`) and `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-interact` (`web/` publishes `@cc-interact/react`, 0.5.0). Both local `main` checkouts are stale (cc-present is 47 commits behind); every lane cuts from freshly fetched `origin/main` under `~/.claude/worktrees/<repo>/<lane>` and leaves the `~/Code` checkouts and `~/.orca/workspaces/cc-present/cc-present-queue` alone.

Owner decisions (recorded as cc-notes answers):

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Preview size | Side panel when wide, **pending** real renders of all four layouts (step 0); only the pick ships |
| Preview at rest | Selected option; with none selected, the last hovered card; first option only before any hover |
| Other box | Text always survives; Other becomes the selected answer as soon as you type |
| Reply toast | Extend cc-interact: title, click-through, longer dwell; show block prompt, your note, the reply |
| Extra fixes | All four groups: lost text, option strip, keyboard and submit, connection and replies |
| Notes | One Add note on every card and top-level block; server accepts notes on any block |
| `allowFeedback` | Removed everywhere, no shim |

Calls made inside those decisions, covered by approving this plan:

- Other fills its radio and clears the prior pick on the first keystroke locally; the POST still goes on blur, Enter, or Cmd+Enter. Posting per keystroke would flood the agent's event log and re-arm the 450 ms auto-advance on every pause (`FocusDeck.tsx:51-59,209`).
- The side panel breaks the deck out of the 900px reading column at a new 1280px breakpoint; inside the column it would leave ~180px option cards.
- `StreamToast` gains `title`, `onClick`, `durationMs`, and `toast` gets a second `ctx` argument (it needs the reduced state).
- Cmd/Ctrl+Enter before the Review step jumps to Review; a second chord submits.
- iOS gets only what keeps it building and decoding (field removal, widened `commentAcceptsFeedback`). No card-level Add note UI on iOS.

## Approach

### 0. Render the four preview layouts (throwaway, gates lane `stage`)

1. Worktree `~/.claude/worktrees/cc-present/stage-scratch`, branch `scratch/stage-layouts`, never pushed.
2. `FocusCard.tsx`: read `?stage=1..4`, set `data-stage-layout` on `.focus-card-body`; variant 4 adds an Enlarge button opening a `detail-modal` dialog (copy the `showModal` effect at `Detail.tsx:64-77`; `Lightbox` is image-only).
3. `focus.css`, one block per variant: (1) `.focus-media { flex: none; max-height: 50vh }`; (2) body `max-height: 85vh`, media sticky top with `order: -1`, bottom-only mask; (3) the grid in lane `stage` below; (4) media `min-height: 8lh; max-height: 12lh`.
4. Fixture from `examples/stress-board.json:1-97` with tall visuals swapped in (12-node `graph TD`, 40-line `code`, an image, one option with no visual); validate with `cc-present push --dry-run`.
5. `cc-present start --new --doc <fixture> --session stage-scratch`, then serve the scratch SPA against the running daemon: `CC_PRESENT_DEV_PORT=<port> bun run dev` (`web/vite.config.ts:31-47`). Never run a scratch-built binary: `start` upgrades the daemon under live boards.
6. `agent-browser` at 1900x1100: per variant, hover the second card, screenshot; one extra at ~1000px for variant 3's fallback.
7. Show the four screenshots on a cc-present board (four `image` blocks, one single-select choice, side panel marked recommended). Close the scratch board, remove the worktree and branch.

### 1. cc-interact 0.6.0 (lane `interact`)

- **Toast API.** `web/src/stream/index.tsx:15-18` `StreamToast` gains `title?`, `onClick?`, `durationMs?`; `:66` `toast(ev, ctx)` with the ctx built at `:187` hoisted and passed at `:198`. `web/src/shell/ToastStack.tsx:58` uses `n.durationMs ?? AUTO_DISMISS_MS[n.kind]`; `:86` wraps title and message in `.toast-body`, a `<button>` when `onClick` is set (run, then dismiss). `web/src/base.css:254-256`: `.toast-body`, `.toast-title` (600, ellipsis), `.toast-msg` `white-space: pre-line` with a 5-line clamp.
- **Optimistic rollback by replay.** `web/src/query/index.ts:62-84`: a per-(client, key) journal `{ base, entries: { step, settled }[] }` opened in `onMutate`; `onError` splices the failed entry and sets the cache to `entries.reduce(step, base)` before `invalidate` and `config.onError`; `onSuccess` marks settled; the journal is dropped once all entries settle. `web/src/stream/index.tsx:176-180` routes each frame's reduce through `applyCacheStep` so frames arriving mid-flight are journalled and survive a rollback. Not exported.
- **Test harness.** `web/` has no runner today: add `vitest` + `jsdom`, a `test` script, `vitest.config.ts`, a CI step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml:59-70`. `web/src/query/index.test.tsx` table: error restores; a step applied between mutate and error survives; A fails/B succeeds; both fail; A succeeds/B fails; `onError` sees the rolled-back cache.
- **Release.** `web/package.json:3` to `0.6.0`, `CHANGELOG.md` `### Added` under Unreleased; after merge, dispatch the Release workflow on `main` (`release.yml:3-6,27-34` publishes when the version is not on npm).
- The lane first confirms against the pinned `@tanstack/query-core` source (via `cc-context:dep-reader`) that `onMutate` runs at dispatch for a `scope`-queued mutation; the journal design assumes it.

### 2. cc-present, wave 1 (file-disjoint lanes, all from `origin/main`)

**Lane `choice`** — `Choice.tsx`, `OptionCard.tsx`, `OptionStrip.tsx`, `styles/blocks.css` (+ tests)

- *Preview at rest* (`Choice.tsx:101-108,141-142`): `pointed` (cleared on leave) and `lastPointed` (sticky); `activeId = pointed ?? picks.at(-1) ?? lastPointed ?? options[0]`. `OptionCard.tsx:49-50` adds `onFocus`/`onBlur` to the same handlers; `choose` (1-9) sets `lastPointed`. Multi-select rests on the most recently checked option still checked.
- *Other box* (`Choice.tsx:44-70,145-199`): delete the sync effect at `:49-51`; derive during render (the pattern at `Clamped.tsx:19-23`) with `draft`, `dirty`, `synced`. A cleared server `other` never touches the draft; a non-empty one is adopted only into an idle clean box. `otherOn = dirty ? text !== '' : committed !== ''`; `picks = !multi && dirty && text ? [] : selected`. Typing sets `dirty` (no POST); blur commits; plain Enter only blurs (fixes today's double POST at `:193-194`); an authored pick posts `other: undefined` and keeps the text; clicking the Other card, its radio, or digit N+1 calls `pickOther()`, which posts the kept text at once.
- *Strip fade* (`blocks.css:528-541,602,1447-1449`): `scroll-padding-inline: var(--strip-fade)` so a snapped card rests outside the 7rem fade; delete `:602`; `--strip-fade: var(--page-pad)` under 720px.
- *Reveal on click*: `pick(i)` = `toggle` + `revealCard(i)` for both `onToggle` (`:140`) and `choose`.
- *Dots* (`OptionStrip.tsx:8-11,58-62`): replace `activeCard` with a pure `inView(left, width, scrollLeft, clientWidth)` half-visible test per child; new `picked: ReadonlySet<number>` prop; `.on` = in view, `.picked` = selected (`blocks.css:641-644`).
- *Round radio*: `blocks.css:407,419` to `border-radius: 50%`. The `--radius-pill` token stays 2px (chips, statuses, dots depend on it).
- *Other textarea* (`blocks.css:1556-1566`): `field-sizing: content; max-height: 6lh; resize: none`; stop the `:has(.option-index)` padding narrowing it.
- *Cmd+Enter*: add `!e.metaKey && !e.ctrlKey` at `OptionCard.tsx:55` and `Choice.tsx:161`, matching `Input.tsx:85`.

**Lane `keys`** — `keyboard.tsx`, `SubmitBar.tsx`, `submit.ts`, `FocusDeck.tsx` (+ tests)

- `keyboard.tsx:281-282`: `?` closes the help dialog (`help-toggle` passes when the open dialog is `.help-dialog`).
- `SubmitBar.tsx:65-67,92,168-185`: arm the confirm on every undecided item; `unansweredSummary(items)` in `submit.ts` ("2 approvals, 1 choice unanswered"); a "Go to first" ghost button after Cancel calling `kbd.jumpTo`. `:193`: label `Submitting…` while `inFlight`.
- Cmd+Enter before Review: `StepNav` (`keyboard.tsx:39-43`) gains `end`; `FocusDeck.tsx:176-179` registers it; the `submit` case (`:319-328`) runs `submitFnRef.current ?? stepNavRef.current?.end`.
- `FocusDeck.tsx:209,221-224`: do not arm auto-advance while a composer is open (needed by the Other-box change).

**Lane `drafts`** — new `web/src/drafts.ts`, `FeedbackThread.tsx`, `Triage.tsx`, `DraftView.tsx`, `Clamped.tsx`, `SingleBlockView.tsx` (+ tests)

- `drafts.ts`: in-memory `DraftStore` keyed by (block id, slot) with `scope(subject, round)`, `useDraft`, `useDrafts`, modelled on `packs/state.ts` and `viewed.ts`. Cleared by a successful send, Cancel, or a round change; never by blur, sheet close, step navigation, a breakpoint flip, or a stream event.
- `FeedbackThread.tsx:36-37,73-82`: text lives in slot `'note'`; a failed POST writes the text back (prepended to anything typed since); a restored draft does not steal focus. This also covers the sheet close (`CommentsSheet.tsx:24-29` needs no change) and the 1100px rail/sheet swap.
- `Triage.tsx:32-33,62-74`: one draft per item id, an editor is open iff its draft exists, so a second note no longer overwrites the first; `sendNote` awaits and clears only on success.
- `DraftView.tsx:67,86-113,121-130`: one composer per draft entry keyed by annotation id; a gutter click starts a new entry unless the active one is empty; clamp the range to `lines.length` before `anchorOf` on send.
- `Clamped.tsx:45-51`: key the re-sync on `[html, contentKey]`; `DraftView.tsx:161` passes `contentKey={block.text}`. `Clamped.tsx:82`: stop propagation only for plain Enter/Space, so shortcuts keep working with the toggle focused.
- `SingleBlockView.tsx`: `draftStore.scope(subject, round)` effect.

**Lane `rail`** — `threadFeed.ts`, `activeBlock.tsx`, `SidebarPanel.tsx`, `RoundGroup.tsx`, `revision.ts`, `CommentChip.tsx`, `MarginRail.tsx`, `app.tsx`, `styles/shell.css`, `styles/tokens.css` (+ tests)

- *Connection lamp*: style `.wire-lamp`, `.wire-dot`, `.wire-live`, `.wire-down` (pulse reusing `focus-dot-pulse`, `focus.css:144`); delete the dead `.conn*` halves at `shell.css:470-493` and `tokens.css:177`, keeping `.peer`.
- *Jump to past rounds*: `ThreadEntry.live`; `activeBlock.tsx` gains `reveal` state, `revealBlock(id)`, `useJump()`; `SidebarPanel.tsx:67-77` uses it; `RoundGroup.tsx:79-86` expands the group holding the target (`key` + `defaultExpanded`, as `FocusCard.tsx:61`) and scrolls its `.round-block`.
- *Unread replies*: `revision.ts:80-91` tracks block ids with a live unread `reply.created`; `CommentChip.tsx` and `MarginRail.tsx:57,65` show `data-unread`; an effect in `app.tsx` marks read when the pinned thread's panel is open.
- `app.tsx:118`: `draftStore.scope(subject, currentRound)` effect.

**Lane `server`** — `internal/daemon/rest.go`, `internal/doc/doc.go`, their tests, `internal/state/testdata/`, `internal/cli/commands_test.go`, `examples/*.json`, `docs/contract.md`, `README.md`, `plugin/skills/present/**`, `CHANGELOG.md`

- `rest.go:305-345`: replace the type switch with `findBlock` + `requireCurrentRound`; delete `allowsFeedback` (`:594-598`) and the decision-note gate (`:249-251`). `doc.go:130`: delete `AllowFeedback`.
- Tests: `TestInteractionFeedbackAnyBlock` (card, card child, content, input, draft, triage, section, non-interactive pack → 200; visual, closed round → 400); `packs_http_test.go:313-314` flips to 200; a `TestDecodeRejectsUnknownFields` row pinning the `allowFeedback` error; shared fixture `feedback-on-card-freezes.json` (consumed by Go, `web/src/reduce.test.ts:67-72`, and iOS conformance).
- Docs and skill: drop the field from `contract.md:37`, `reference/blocks.md:114,123`, `README.md:108`, both examples; `contract.md:422`, `reference/event-schema.md:11`, `SKILL.md:27,111` say every card and top-level block takes a note and `blockId` may be a card or content block. `slop-cop check --llm-effort=off` on each doc.

**Lane `ios`** — `Doc.swift:147-161`, `Comments.swift:61-73`, `ios/CcPresent/Blocks/ApprovalBlockView.swift:38-40,67,192,209`, `CommentsTests.swift`, `DocCodableTests.swift`: remove the property and its gates.

### 3. cc-present, wave 2 (cut from the assembled wave-1 tip)

**Lane `stage`** — `FocusCard.tsx`, `styles/focus.css` (after the step-0 pick; described for the side panel)

- `FocusCard.tsx:313-318`: `staged` = the step holds a choice with any `visual`; `data-stage` on `.focus-card-body`; `StageMedia` (`:72-90`) renders a `data-empty` placeholder when the active option has no visual, so cards never reflow under the pointer.
- `focus.css:397-404`: `.focus-media { flex: none; max-height: 50vh }` (the stacked fallback, never squeezed); at `min-width: 1280px` the deck breaks out to `min(84rem, …)` and `.focus-card-body[data-stage]` becomes an `11fr / 9fr` grid with the preview sticky in column 2 at `max-height: 70vh`. Compact `<details>` body (`:420-423`) rises to 50vh.
- Also owns the one-token `note` prop at `FocusCard.tsx:327` and the note chip row in `focus.css` for lane `threads`.
- If step 0 picks another layout: (1) ships only the two base rules; (2) the sticky-top CSS with a bottom-only mask; (4) the clamp plus an Enlarge button on a modal shell extracted from `Detail.tsx:60-110`.

**Lane `threads`** — new `components/BlockThread.tsx`, `threadFeed.ts`, `Approval.tsx`, `PackBlockView.tsx`, `BlockRenderer.tsx`, `BoardBlocks.tsx`, `RoundGroup.tsx`, `schema.ts`, `keymap.ts`, `Choice.tsx`, `FocusDeck.tsx`, `keyboard.tsx`, `SidebarPanel.tsx`, `app.tsx`, `styles/blocks.css`

- `BlockThread` replaces the three hand-wired `rail ? CommentChip : FeedbackThread` copies and `engage` ternaries in `Approval.tsx`, `Choice.tsx`, `PackBlockView.tsx`; the chip reads "Continue note" when a draft exists.
- Rule: approvals, choices, and interactive packs own their thread; every other block's note goes to its enclosing top-level block, so the id is always `step.block.id`. `BlockRenderer.tsx:63-72` takes a `note` prop rendering `BlockNote`; passed from `BoardBlocks.tsx:52`, `RoundGroup.tsx:83`, `FocusCard.tsx:327`. Not in `SingleBlockView` (the iOS embed).
- `threadFeed.ts`: delete `ThreadKind`/`threadKind`/`FALLBACK_LABEL`; admit every block; export `ownsThread` and `noteCopy(type)`; map `activeId` to its owner for the pin; lock entries on a closed board or stale round (fixes the live composer at `:82`). `app.tsx:309` follows the mapping.
- Keyboard: `keyboard.tsx` gains `registerNote` (mirrors `registerSubmit`, `:194-196`); `engage` (`:313-318`) falls through to it; `FocusDeck.tsx` registers the current step's note; `jumpTo` (`:215-226`) scrolls a non-ring id's `[data-block-id]` row. One `keymap.ts` row.
- Remove `allowFeedback` from `schema.ts:73`, `Approval.tsx:30`, `threadFeed.test.ts:7-11`.
- Carried for lane `toast` (same files): `useThreadOpener(...)` in `app.tsx` `PresentShell`; `Choice.commitOther` keeps the draft on a failed POST.

**Lane `toast`** — `stream.ts`, `markdown.ts`, new `threadOpen.ts`, `Input.tsx`, `Triage.tsx`, `web/package.json`, `web/bun.lock`, new `api.test.tsx` (needs 0.6.0 on npm)

- `web/package.json:13` to `^0.6.0`.
- `stream.ts:48-53,74`: `toastFor(frame, state)`; for `reply.created` resolve `threadFeed(state, frame.blockId, …).pinned` and return `{ title: entry.label, text: "You: <latest note>\nAgent: <reply as plain text>", durationMs: 12_000, onClick }`; a block with no thread keeps the generic text. `markdown.ts` gains `markdownText(md)`. `threadOpen.ts` is a module sink copied from `packs/toasts.ts:13-31`; the click jumps to the block and pins its thread open.
- Rollback consumers: `Input.tsx:40-44,65,75` keeps the failed text in draft slot `'input'`; `Triage.sendNote` already awaits (lane `drafts`); `api.test.tsx` asserts a rejected POST restores `decisions`.

### 4. Ship

- cc-interact: one PR via the `open-pr` skill; merge, dispatch Release, confirm `@cc-interact/react@0.6.0` on npm.
- cc-present: one stack, one branch per lane, in the order `choice`, `keys`, `drafts`, `rail`, `stage`, `server`+`ios`+`threads` (one PR: the field removal must be atomic across Go, web, iOS, docs), `toast`. Each PR opens ready with a body; a background `pr-watcher` per PR.
- When the stack is green: ask "merge now?", then tag the next `v0.41.0` on `origin/main` (goreleaser, Homebrew, autobump), `claude plugin marketplace update` + `claude plugin update cc-present`, and confirm `cc-present --version`.

Not in scope (found, not offered): no confirm on triage Accept all/Reject all; arrow keys captured on a focused radio card; older toasts reappearing after newer ones expire.

## Potential Pitfalls

- **Open boards break on upgrade.** The daemon re-decodes stored docs strictly (`internal/state/reduce.go:244`), so any board whose log carries `allowFeedback` fails every interaction after the upgrade; the only recovery is `start --replace`. The skill's own approval example sets the key today, so this will be common. Install when no board that matters is open.
- **Rollback regresses three call sites** that relied on the optimistic copy surviving a failure (`Input.tsx:65,75`, `Choice.tsx:49-51`, `Triage.tsx:68-74`); the `^0.6.0` bump must land with their failure handling, which is why they sit in the same PR.
- **A round change drops unsent drafts**, including when the agent starts a round mid-typing.
- **`draftStore` is a module singleton**: tests that type into a composer need `afterEach(() => draftStore.reset())`; `FocusDeck.test.tsx:262,276,464` reuse block ids.
- **jsdom has no layout**: the fade, snap, sticky grid, deck breakout, `field-sizing`, round radio, wire lamp, toast clamp, and the tap-to-click race behind the Other wipe are checked only in a browser.
- **Scrolling a clicked card under a still pointer** can fire `mouseenter` on its neighbour and flip the preview; check after `choice` and `stage` meet.
- **`scroll-padding`** moves where `scrollIntoView` and the arrow nudge land; recheck 721-1099px and phones.
- **Lanes cannot typecheck alone** in wave 2 (`BlockRenderer`'s `note` prop, `useThreadOpener`, `threadFeed` shape cross lanes); only the assembled tree is graded.
- **A note on a content-only board** now counts as engagement (`rounds.go:58-70,89`), so the agent's next push adding a top-level block needs `--round`. The skill text says so.

## Workflow Plan

The main agent holds the plan, the step-0 board and its pick, lane assembly, and the merge question; it records the plan in cc-notes (`plan_add`) at start. Everything with a diff is a lane in `~/.claude/worktrees/<repo>/<lane>`; lanes commit locally and do not run suites.

| Phase | Shape | Agents | Blocks on | Verification |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0. Layout renders: four screenshots on a board | pipeline | opus high ×1 | — | Owner picks a layout on the board |
| 1. `interact`: toast API, rollback journal, vitest harness; done when the PR is green | pipeline | opus xhigh ×1 | — | cc-interact CI (build + new vitest step) |
| 1r. Merge, dispatch Release, 0.6.0 on npm | pipeline | sonnet low ×1 (`ship-pr`, `pr-watcher`) | 1 | `npm view @cc-interact/react version` = 0.6.0 |
| 2. Wave 1: `choice`, `keys`, `drafts`, `rail`, `server`, `ios`; each done when its files match the spec and are committed | parallel | opus xhigh ×3 (`choice`, `drafts`, `rail`), opus high ×3 (`keys`, `server`, `ios`) | — | Assembled tree: CI on the pushed stack |
| 3. Wave 2: `stage`, `threads`, `toast`; same completion condition | parallel | opus xhigh ×2 (`threads`, `stage`), opus high ×1 (`toast`) | 2; `stage` also on 0; `toast` also on 1r | Assembled tree: CI on the pushed stack |
| 4. Review: one finder over the full stack diff and the cc-interact diff | pipeline | gpt-6.1-sol xhigh ×1 (codex) | 3 | Findings fixed or refuted, one pass |
| 5. Browser pass on a scratch board against the assembled SPA (vite proxy), checklist below | pipeline | opus high ×1 | 3 | Screenshot per checklist item |
| 6. Submit stack, watch, merge on yes, tag, install | pipeline | sonnet low ×1 per PR (`ship-pr`, `pr-watcher`) | 4, 5 | CI green; `cc-present --version` shows the new tag |

## Verification

- **CI** (the gate): cc-present `ci.yml` runs `bun run typecheck`, `bunx vitest run`, `bunx vite build`, the pack builds, and `go test -race`; `ci-ios.yml` builds and tests iOS; cc-interact CI gains the vitest step. No local `go test`.
- **Browser checklist** (CI cannot grade it), on the step-0 fixture plus a board with an input-only card, a content-only card, an approval, a long draft, and a triage block:
  1. Preview: hover each card at 1900x1100 and at ~1000px; the chosen layout shows the whole visual; leaving the strip rests on the selection, else the last hovered card.
  2. Other: type, click the Other radio and label, pick another option, click Other again — the text is there each time and exactly one answer is selected; Cmd+Enter in the box submits.
  3. Strip: the snapped card is undimmed; clicking a half-visible card scrolls it in; dots reach the last card and mark the pick; single-select radios are round.
  4. `cc-present reply --block <id> --body …`: the toast shows prompt, your note, the reply, stays ~12 s, and a click opens that thread; the chip shows unread until opened.
  5. Notes: every card has Add note, including input-only and content-only ones; the note reaches `cc-present outcomes` keyed to the card id; `f` on a context step opens it.
  6. Lost text: kill the daemon mid-POST — a choice un-selects and a note returns to the composer; a half-written note survives closing the sheet, Next/Back, and starting a second note; Show more stays open while typing.
  7. Stop the daemon: the lamp turns to a pulsing RECONNECTING; Jump on a past-round thread expands and scrolls to it.
  8. `?` toggles help; Submit with unanswered choices names them and Go to first jumps; the button reads Submitting….
- **After install**: `cc-present --version` is the new tag, and a fresh board with a doc containing `allowFeedback` is rejected with `unknown field "allowFeedback"`.
